title: Monotonicity of a pair of indicators
statement: Let $P_+,P_-,A_+,A_-$ be decidable propositions. If $P_+$ implies $A_+$ and $P_-$ implies $A_-$, then $\mathbf 1_{P_+}+\mathbf 1_{P_-}\leq\mathbf 1_{A_+}+\mathbf 1_{A_-}$, where each indicator is $1$ when its proposition holds and $0$ otherwise.
